benefit_text: The scheme gives one-year term life cover of ₹ 2.00 Lakh. It covers death due to any reason. The premium is ₹ 436/- per annum per subscriber. The premium is auto debited from bank or post office account.
who_can_apply: People aged 18 to 50 Years can apply. Applicants must hold an individual bank or post office account.
documents: The form asks for self-attested copies of required papers.
how_to_apply: Applicants fill and sign the consent-cum-declaration form. Applicants attach self-attested copies of required papers. Applicants submit the case to the official of the bank or post office.
